name: Book Appointment
description: Book a scheduled healthcare appointment for a patient with a practitioner from the organisation's directory.

intent_examples: Make an appointment for a patient
Book a patient with a doctor
when_to_use: User wants to book or schedule a new appointment
User wants to create an appointment for a patient
User provides a patient and wants to schedule a visit with a practitioner
when_not_to_use: User wants to view or list existing appointments
User wants to cancel or update an appointment
User wants to create a patient record (use create_patient instead)

introduction: I'll help you book an appointment. Select a practitioner from your organisation's directory, choose a date and time, and confirm the booking.

completion.message: Appointment booked successfully. The patient and practitioner have been notified.

workflow_steps.name: Book Appointment
workflow_steps.description: Select a practitioner, set the appointment date and time, choose a status, and optionally add an appointment type and description.

context_resolvers.description: Fetch active practitioners available for booking in this organisation.
Fetch appointment status value set for the Status terminology select.
Fetch appointment-type value set for the Appointment Type terminology select.
